messages:
Lena: Quick sync — we need to finalize the beta launch blog (hero + 3 proof bullets + CTA) and confirm bench callouts for the assets library. Can people do a final sweep by EOD? :eyes:
Omar: I'm on hero variants and microcopy for CTAs. Will drop options in the doc in 20.
Priya: I'll handle the benchmark paragraph and chart callouts. Planning to reference our internal perf suite (v2) and include a short note about workloads used.
Ravi: Heads up on the webinar/demo side: we have two demo pods today (11am/3pm). Recommend 3pm for public launch demo. Can reserve 3pm if marketing wants it pinned.
Jules: I'll wire the HubSpot form mapping and hidden UTMs. Need final naming for utm_campaign and lead_source. Suggest utm_campaign=beta_playbook_v1, lead_source=newsletter.
Lena: Good rec. Also want a short inline CTA to register for "Launch demo" + a secondary CTA to "Request dedicated eval" (for enterprise leads).
Omar: Dropped copy in doc: hero v2 chosen; CTA primary = "Register for launch demo"; secondary = "Request a dedicated eval". Kept CTAs under 6 words. Link: https://docs.google.com/drive/xxx
Priya: Bench numbers: median latency down 2.8x, 95th percentile down 1.9x in our tests vs. baseline. Wording suggestion: "median latency up to 2.8x faster in our internal benchmarks". Avoid absolutes per legal.
Sam (Legal): Quick note: approve "up to 2.8x faster in our internal benchmarks". Do not use "best" or "always". For dedicated eval CTA copy, add: "subject to qualification". I can sign off by 3:30pm.
Jules: HubSpot hidden field snippet (pasting here):
```
hidden_fields:
  utm_source: newsletter
  utm_campaign: beta_playbook_v1
  lead_route: beta_inbound
  demo_slot: 15:00
```
Jules: Also adding routing: if company_size > 250 -> assign to Enterprise SDR pool, else beta_inbound queue.
Ravi: Calendly pinned 15:00 demo, updated event name to "Redwood Beta Launch Demo". I tested flows and got confirmation email ok.
Lena: Awesome. Two small asks: (1) Priya, add one-sentence context about workload used for benchmarks (tokens/sec, avg seq len). (2) Omar, please include alt headline for social push.
Omar: Will add both, done in doc at 16:10. Alt headline: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency & cost".
Priya: Added workload context: "tests run on 1xA100 equivalent, batch mix of short/medium seq (avg 128 tokens) using our perf harness v2."
Sam (Legal): Confirmed: legal sign-off granted for current language and CTAs (see comment in doc). Minor tweak: add "internal" qualifier next to benchmarks.
Lena: Locking CTAs and bench phrasing. Proposed publish window: tomorrow 11am PT. If no objections by 4:30pm today I'll schedule publish and tweet thread. :rocket:
